name: Free Online CORS Checker - ATools
description: Free online CORS checker: enter URL, method, headers and body to predict preflight and get common fixes for CORS errors.
seoDescription: Free online CORS checker by ATools: enter an API URL, HTTP method, request headers and body to predict whether the browser will trigger an OPTIONS preflight request, and get actionable fix suggestions for common CORS failures (missing Access-Control-Allow-Origin, methods/headers mismatch, credentials with wildcard origin, and more). Runs fully in-browser; no data is uploaded.

ui.headers: Request Headers (One per line: Key: Value)
ui.bodyTypeText: Plain Text (text/plain, usually does not trigger preflight)
ui.bodyTypeForm: Form (application/x-www-form-urlencoded, usually does not trigger preflight)
ui.assumedOriginHint: Only affects suggested response headers; actual request Origin is determined by the current page.
ui.errRequestFailed: Request failed (likely CORS or network error).
ui.probeOkOpaque: Target reachable (opaque, body unreadable) — CORS is likely blocking access.
ui.probeFailed: Probe also failed — likely network/DNS/TLS/blocked error.
ui.preflightYes: Yes (server must respond properly to OPTIONS)
ui.preflightNo: No (usually does not trigger OPTIONS preflight)
ui.pasteHeaders: Paste observed response headers (Optional, for detailed diagnostics)
ui.pasteHeadersHint: Copy response headers or preflight response headers from DevTools -> Network and paste here (Key: Value per line).
ui.reasonMethodNotSimple: Method {method} is not a simple request method (GET/HEAD/POST).
ui.suggestionSameOrigin: This URL is same-origin with current page: CORS is not triggered, browser will not block cross-origin reads.
ui.suggestionCrossOriginServerOnly: CORS for cross-origin requests is entirely determined by server response headers; frontend cannot bypass it.
ui.suggestionCredentialsOrigin: When including credentials/cookies: server must return Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true, and Access-Control-Allow-Origin cannot be * (must be an explicit Origin).
ui.suggestionCrossSiteCookie: If relying on cross-site cookies: server cookies must have SameSite=None; Secure (and use HTTPS).
ui.suggestionHandlePreflight: Handle OPTIONS preflight: return 204/200 for OPTIONS with Allow-Origin/Allow-Methods/Allow-Headers.
ui.suggestionNetworkErrorTip: Browsers typically only show "TypeError: Failed to fetch" on CORS failure. Inspect DevTools -> Network for preflight/response headers.
ui.suggestionForbiddenHeaders: These headers are forbidden from being set by browsers (will be ignored or error): {headers}.
ui.suggestionInvalidHeaders: The following header names are invalid (not sent): {headers}.
ui.issueMissingAcao: Missing Access-Control-Allow-Origin (browser will block cross-origin read).
ui.issueMultipleAcao: Access-Control-Allow-Origin should not contain multiple comma-separated values; use * or a single Origin.
ui.issueWildcardWithCredentials: Access-Control-Allow-Origin cannot be * when credentials are included.
ui.issueMissingAcac: Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true is required when credentials are included.
ui.snippetNginxComment: # Nginx Example (adjust to whitelist; do not allow arbitrary Origin on sensitive APIs)
ui.snippetExpressComment: // Express Example (use cors middleware with whitelist recommended)
ui.snippetSpringComment: // Spring Boot Example (sample; configure as needed)
ui.responsePlaceholder: (On CORS success) Response body preview will appear here; unreadable on failure.
ui.diagnosticsNoIssues: No obvious issues detected (or request does not require CORS/preflight).
